title: Go: Time and Timers
description: Work with time, durations, formatting, parsing, timers, and tickers in Go.

steps.title: time.Now formatting
steps.description: Print the current time using `time.Now()` formatted as "2006-01-02 15:04:05" using `Format`. Output should look like "Current: 2026-06-01 10:30:00".
hints: Go uses a reference time: `Mon Jan 2 15:04:05 MST 2006`
The reference time must be exact — these specific numbers

verification.successMessage: Time formatted with Go's reference time layout!
verification.failureMessage: Use the exact reference time digits in your format string.

steps.title: time.Parse
steps.description: Parse the string "2026-01-15" using `time.Parse("2006-01-02", str)`. Print the parsed time in a different format: "January 15, 2026".
hints: The layout must match the input format
Use the parsed time's `.Format()` to produce the output

verification.failureMessage: Match the layout string to the input date format.

steps.title: Duration calculations
steps.description: Calculate the difference between two times: `start := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)` and `end := time.Date(2026, 6, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)`. Print the difference in hours.

verification.failureMessage: Use the Sub method to get the duration between times.

steps.title: Time.Ticker
steps.description: Create a `time.Ticker` that ticks every 500ms. Print "Tick" for 3 ticks, then stop the ticker and print "Stopped".
hints: Read from `ticker.C` channel for each tick

verification.failureMessage: Read from the ticker's C channel to receive ticks.

steps.title: time.After
steps.description: Use `time.After(1 * time.Second)` as a timeout in a select. Create a channel that sends "done" after 2 seconds. The select should timeout first and print "Timed out waiting".
hints: Use in select alongside your work channel
For a timeout, the After channel fires before the work completes

verification.successMessage: time.After creates a timer channel for select!
verification.failureMessage: Use time.After in a select case for timeout behavior.
